review.why: Manages brand voice, visual identity and assets, and syncs a brand guidelines file into design tokens with bundled scripts.
review.summary: Covers voice and messaging frameworks, visual identity, color and typography specs, logo rules, asset organization and consistency checks. Scripts inject brand context, validate assets, extract colors and sync a guidelines file to token files, stopping if existing token files or theme variables are detected unless forced. An update subcommand and eleven reference files go deeper.
strengths: Sync stops before overwriting existing tokens or theme variables
One source of truth: the guidelines file feeds tokens and CSS variables
Templates and checklists for approval and consistency
cautions: Eleven reference files and five scripts are not read here
Needs Node to run the helpers
Targets teams that keep brand rules in files
